definitions.explanation: Describes moving around restlessly without purpose or direction, often implying confusion or suspicion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧うろうろ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got lost and wandered around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不審|ふしん}{者|しゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧うろうろ⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A suspicious person is loitering in front of the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、うろうろ⟦してしまった→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't find the station exit and ended up wandering around.

notes:
うろうろ is an onomatopoeic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) expressing restless, purposeless movement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- うろうろ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wander about, pace around
- うろうろ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk around aimlessly

NUANCE: Can imply confusion, nervousness, or suspicious behavior. More restless than ⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧: wandering aimlessly (more relaxed)
- ⟦おろおろ→おろおろ：05369_orooro⟧: flustered, bewildered (emotional confusion)
